notes.title: Update - Demo Build v0.2
notes.content:
Demo build v0.2 is live!
This update contains a decent amount of changes, which I'll do my best to outline below. As always, feedback encouraged! There's a feedback button in the game menu which links to a Google form. Feel free to post in the community hub as well. Bug reporting is also much appreciated!

Changes:

Settlers

Added settler stats: Efficiency, Immunity, and Devotion.
Added daily resource needs: Food, Medicine, and Influence
Added conditions: Hunger, Health, and Devotion
Added Diseases, which can be contracted by settlers with low Health
Added the Coup event, which is started by settlers with low Devotion
Removed settler Happiness


Resources

Added Medicine resources, which are consumed to keep settler Health high
Trees now regrow
Flax now regrows
Some Medicine resources regrow
Resource spawn rates changed


Structures

Added Wood Bridge
Added Mushroom Cellar
Added Purple Mushroom Cellar
Added Jammery
Removed Kitchen
Gardening Shed now must be placed on existing Fertile Soil
Explorer Tent area reduced; auto-packs when area clear
Reworked Tavern and Town Hall
Many structure build requirements changed


Miscellaneous

Winter now prevents many resources from growing
Month length shortened to 25 days
Harvest structures now highlight resources in range
Added Info Hover to resources
Added Info Tooltip when building

notes.title: Add Settlement Stats, Controls Display, and Menu Button
notes.content:
There's a new menu in the top right with 3 buttons, which activate the following:


 New stats display, which shows some lifetime settlement stats such as total influence, resources collected, etc.
 Controls display, can now be accessed whenever
 Save/load/settings menu can now be opened with a button instead of only by pressing esc

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Audio settings now save and do not need to be readjusted between game launches
 Town hall and tavern won't show destroy notification if they have housing in their areas
 Exploring settlers can become lost and trapped in the fog. They will now respawn the next day at the settler's tent
 Stopped gold spawning as it's not harvestable yet
 Remove incorrect new structure notifications on load
 Fixed some bugs around settler auto-work

notes.title: Ore Info Tip and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Add tip about smelting ore with furnace when ore discovered
 Fix unclearable new structure notifications being loaded after save
 Fix wood resource menu being visible upon new game start

notes.title: Gardening Shed Now Produces Both Flax and Wheat, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Gardening shed now has a 50% chance to grow flax and a 50% chance to grow wheat
 Gardening shed build cost changed
 Added a feedback button to main menu and esc menu which links to a Google form
 Fix some small resource menu bugs

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed explorer's tent not updating resource pool when blockers are removed
 Fixed placement of new structure notification icons
 Fixed new structure notifications not saving
 Settlers will now only "go inside" after working hours

notes.title: Add Production/Harvesting Building Tabs and Quarry Structure
notes.content:
Separated building production tab into two separate tabs: harvesting and production. Harvesting structures simply "harvest" the existing resources around them, while production structures can "produce" new ones.
 Added a new structure, the quarry, which can "produce" stone.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Two bugs patched, the first of which was reported by multiple players:


 Fix crash on settler recruitment when player had previously destroyed a housing structure
 Fix crash when building new housing after immediate in-game load
